description: This file defines a class 'Single' within the 'PhpSpreadsheet' calculation library, focused on financial cash flow calculations such as future value, periods needed for an investment, and interest rate required for growth. It contains static methods implementing these financial computations.

classes.name: Single
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform specific financial cash flow calculations such as future value, period calculation, and interest rate computation.

methods.name: futureValue
methods.description: Calculates the future value of an investment after applying a series of interest rates, analogous to the Excel FVSCHEDULE function.

methods.name: periods
methods.description: Calculates the number of periods required for an investment to reach a specified future value, given rate, present, and future values.

methods.name: interestRate
methods.description: Computes the interest rate needed for an investment to grow to a specified future value over a number of periods.
